bankrollSystem.name: Kickline Bankroll v3 (focused aggressive)
rules: Each Monday (Pacific) the week opens with 500 fresh paper credits. Each week is scored on its own; nothing rolls over.
Weekly stake limit is 700, and it rises by every credit won that week, up to 1,200. A bet is never larger than the cash not yet staked.
Goal: grow the week's 500 to 1,000 (stretch 1,500). Once settled value reaches 1,000, no new bets until Monday.
Protect mode: once settled value reaches 750, parlay stakes are halved for the rest of the week so a hot week is not given back.
Stop rule: when fewer than 50 credits are left to stake, the week stops.

Singles (up to 200 a week, 120 per scan): 3★ and up only — 5★ 90, 4★ 70, 3★ 50. No 2★ singles (they were 13-6 but lost 31 credits on 380 staked). No singles on spreads, totals, favorites of −100 to −149 or underdogs of +100 to +149.

Parlays (up to 550 a week, one batch per Pacific day): 60 on the 3-leg, 40 on the 4-leg, and 30 on a second 3-leg built from candidates 4-6 when 6+ legs qualify. Full stake only when every leg is 70%+ confidence; otherwise half stake. Nothing on the 5-leg. 5 on the biggest ticket of 6 to 10 legs as a long shot (up to 35 a week); never stake 11- or 12-leg tickets (0-8).
Parlay suggestions still run from 3 up to 12 legs each scan for the board; only the stakes above are placed.
Stakes are fixed when placed and settle from the graded results: a win pays stake × decimal odds, a push or void returns the stake.

Why v3 (Nov 9): over Oct 12 – Nov 8, singles returned +6 on 1,250 staked (3★ +36, 2★ −31), while 3-leg parlays made +176 on 410 (+43%) and 4-leg +122 on 250 (+49%). v3 moves money from 2★ singles into 3- and 4-leg tickets of 70%+ legs (70%+ picks are 48-7) and splits the 3-leg risk across two tickets.
Reality check: these results come from four weeks and overlapping tickets, so the true edge is smaller and less certain than it looks. A bad week can now lose 350+ credits.

kv.name: K×V paper account (Kickline × Match Vision)
rules: Starts with 250 paper credits on Nov 6, 2026 and runs continuously (no weekly reset). No real money; no betting site is connected.
A leg qualifies only when Kickline's pick is a moneyline or draw with 2★+ and 60%+ confidence, and a Match Vision read imported within 7 days of kickoff leans the same way.
Each scan builds one K×V parlay from the qualifying legs that start in the next 72 hours: at least 2 legs, at most 6, highest confidence first, one leg per game.
Every ticket is staked 5 credits, at most one new ticket per Pacific day, and never the same set of legs twice.
The account stops when its balance falls below 5 credits.
Tickets settle from Kickline's graded results: a win pays 5 × the ticket's decimal odds, a push or void returns the stake.
